samples.prompt: Ms Brown has contacted you for professional advice about smartphones in the classroom. Suggest a practical first step, explain a possible difficulty and recommend a way to address it.
requirementsVi: Lời khuyên lịch sự, không dùng giọng trò chuyện với bạn thân.

samples.summaryVi: Điện thoại có ích khi có nhiệm vụ rõ; thông báo và luật dùng không rõ dễ gây xao nhãng.

paragraphs.label: Mở thư và mục đích
paragraphs.text:
Dear Ms Brown,

Thank you for contacting me about smartphones in the classroom. I am writing to offer some suggestions in response to your request. I understand that you would like a practical starting point, and I hope the following advice will be useful.

Thank you for contacting me about [chủ đề]. I am writing to offer some suggestions in response to your request. I understand that you would like a practical starting point, and I hope the following advice will be useful.

paragraphs.label: Đề xuất đầu
paragraphs.text: I would recommend attending a digital learning workshop. This would give you an opportunity to try a phone-based research task and discuss classroom rules. One potential benefit is that students can quickly access useful learning material. For example, a class can compare two digital maps to explain how a neighbourhood has changed.

paragraphs.label: Khó khăn và giải pháp
paragraphs.text: It is also worth considering that notifications can distract students. A practical response would be to agree on specific times for phone use and keep devices away during other tasks. For instance, a teacher could allow phones for a five-minute research task and then ask students to put them in their bags. I would suggest trying this on a small scale before making a longer-term commitment.

paragraphs.text: I would recommend attending a balanced social media workshop. This would give you an opportunity to review phone habits and plan useful limits. One potential benefit is that people can protect time for study, work and sleep. For example, a student can put the phone away after answering messages and spend the next hour preparing for a test.
